title: PPProbe commandlet fail-loudly error paths have zero automated coverage
evidence: PPProbeCommandlet.cpp: `UE_LOG(LogPPProbe, Error, TEXT("PPProbe: bad -seed value '%s' (must be a decimal u64)"), *Switch);` / `UE_LOG(LogPPProbe, Error, TEXT("PPProbe: bad -ticks value '%s' (must be >= 1)"), *Switch);` / `UE_LOG(LogPPProbe, Error, TEXT("PPProbe failed to write %s"), *JsonPath);` — the ONLY PPProbe invocation repo-wide is run-tests-headless.sh:74: `-run=PPProbe -seed=42 -ticks=100 $ARGS \` (hardcoded valid values; grep across scripts/, tests/, Source/ finds no other invocation and no automation test touches the commandlet).
detail: Only invocation repo-wide passes hardcoded valid -seed=42 -ticks=100. Bad-arg rejection and write-failure-before-RESULT ordering never execute in any test; a silent-fallback regression would pass all seven gates.
recommended_fix: Add a negative gate: run PPProbe with -seed=abc and -ticks=0, expect nonzero exit and no 'RESULT=OK' in the log; also assert the unwritable -json path returns 1.

title: RngRange int64-span boundary test exists only in the standalone runner, not the UE automation suite
evidence: spine_check.cpp: `// spans wider than INT32_MAX must not overflow (int64 span math)` / `PP::FRng F;` / `PP::RngSeed(F, 3);` / `const int32_t Wide = PP::RngRange(F, INT32_MIN, INT32_MAX);` / `CHECK(Wide >= INT32_MIN && Wide <= INT32_MAX, "full-int32 span must stay in range");` — PP_RngTests.cpp FPPRngRangeBounds ends at `TestEqual(TEXT("inverted span must return lo"), PP::RngRange(R, 9, 3), 9);` with no INT32_MIN/INT32_MAX draw (grep: INT32_MIN appears only in PP_Rng.h:75 comment and tests/spine_check.cpp).
detail: PP_Rng.h:75 (`// The span is computed in int64 (NOT int32) so spans > INT32_MAX don't`) pins the ODN-10 rationale, but the full-int32-span boundary runs only in spine-check; the engine-side mirror omits it.
recommended_fix: Mirror spine_check.cpp:107-111 in FPPRngRangeBounds: seed an FRng, draw RngRange(F, INT32_MIN, INT32_MAX), assert the result stays within int32 bounds.

title: Gate 3 bash -n syntax check misses scripts/lib/engine.sh (non-recursive glob)
evidence: static-check.py docstring line 9: `  4. Scripts in scripts/ pass bash -n (syntax).` — implementation line 53: `    for sh in sorted((ROOT / "scripts").glob("*.sh")):` — pathlib glob('*.sh') matches direct children only; runtime probe on the worktree lists only ['scripts/compare-golden.sh', 'scripts/format-check.sh', 'scripts/install-engine.sh', 'scripts/local-ci.sh', 'scripts/run-tests-headless.sh'] — scripts/lib/engine.sh (new in this diff, sourced by local-ci.sh, run-tests-headless.sh, install-engine.sh) is unmatched.
detail: A syntax error in scripts/lib/engine.sh would pass gate 3 and only surface later when an engine-gated script sources it, weakening the pre-engine CI loop.
recommended_fix: Change the glob to '**/*.sh' (recursive) in static-check.py's bash -n loop so scripts/lib/engine.sh is syntax-checked.

title: compare-golden.sh mismatch-detection branches never exercised by any test
evidence: compare-golden.sh: `    print("GOLDEN MISMATCH:", ", ".join(f"{k}: {a.get(k)} vs {b.get(k)}" for k in bad))` and `    print("ENGINE PROBE MISMATCH:", ", ".join(f"{k}: {a.get(k)} vs {b.get(k)}" for k in bad))` — docs/timings.md shows gate 7 has only ever passed: `2026-08-20T19:39:47	gate 7	ENGINE:Golden compare (PPProbe vs standalone vs docs/goldens/)	PASS	0s`; no test in the repo feeds the comparator a mismatched pair.
detail: The enforcement arm of the golden discipline (mismatch detection) has never run a failing case; a broken comparator (e.g. inverted condition) would false-green gate 7.
recommended_fix: Extract the embedded python comparison into a function; add a negative self-test with doctored fixture JSONs asserting exit 1 on both branches (golden-vs-standalone and engine-probe-vs-standalone).

title: bin/vision-read fail-loudly contract untested and outside every syntax gate
evidence: bin/vision-read: `if [ ! -f "$IMG" ]; then` / `  echo "vision-read: no such image: $IMG" >&2` / `  exit 1` / `fi` and `vision-read: no vision backend configured (VISION_READ_BACKEND unset).` — grep repo-wide: vision-read is referenced only by docs and AGENTS.md; no test invokes it, and static-check.py:53 scans only scripts/*.sh so bin/vision-read (no .sh suffix) gets no bash -n either.
detail: The screenshot-verification entry point's never-guess contract (exit 1 on missing image / no backend) is documented in AGENTS.md but verified by nothing; a regression to exit 0 would silently pass.
recommended_fix: Add a two-line CI check: run bin/vision-read with VISION_READ_BACKEND unset (expect exit 1) and with a bogus path (expect exit 1).
